feed.summary: Implemented Night Master (103) — Bullseye: winning with doubles instantly destroys the first enemy sideline ghost with less than 4 HP (`hp=0, ko=true, killedBy=103`), with `BULLSEYE!` queued in ghost-rare purple and a `renderBattle()` onShow callback so the sideline greying is visually synchronized with the callout splash.
feed.next_up: Implement Skylar (104) — Winter Barrage: Ice Shards deal +2 damage instead of +1. Check boobattles/execution.js for the exact implementation; likely modifies the Ice Shard damage multiplier in the resource-commit section.

feed.roast: Six months past the Kickstarter deadline and you're still timing purple splash callouts on a sideline KO that triggers on doubles against sub-4 HP ghosts — Rosewater would call that a Timmy win condition buried behind a Spike probability gate.

feed.summary: Implemented Redd (98) — Notorious: entry fires a `NOTORIOUS!` ghost-rare callout and sets `f.reddFirstRoll = true`; `doPreRollSetup` consumes the flag to silently add +2 to that team's dice count for Redd's first roll only, then clears the flag — so subsequent rounds revert to the normal 3-die count.
feed.next_up: Implement Night Master (103) — first Frost Valley ghost-rare. Check boobattles/execution.js for Night Master's ability and port faithfully.
feed.after_that: Implement Skylar (104) — next Frost Valley ghost-rare. Check boobattles reference for Skylar's "Winter Barrage" ability.
feed.roast: A one-shot dice buff gated behind a boolean flag is basically Redd showing up, flexing once, and then filing for unemployment with the rest of your unfinished September roster.

feed.summary: Implemented Toby (97) — Pure Heart: a YES/NO declaration modal fires before Toby rolls each round; YES guarantees an instant KO if Toby wins (damage boosted to exactly KO enemy via normal Beat-3 HP resolution + `PURE HEART!` callout in ghost-rare purple), then `pureHeartScheduledKO` carries across the round boundary so next round's `doPreRollSetup` KO's Toby before rolling with its own pre-roll `PURE HEART!` callout — the full self-sacrifice arc plays out cinematically across two rounds.
feed.next_up: Implement Redd (98) — Dark Castle ghost-rare. Check boobattles/execution.js for Redd's ability and port faithfully.
feed.after_that: Implement Night Master (103) — first Frost Valley ghost-rare. Check boobattles reference for Night Master's ability then implement.
feed.roast: Toby's signature mechanic is a YES/NO popup that spans two rounds just to flavor-text a coin flip — Rosewater calls that "new player experience," Garfield calls it "a modal dialog with extra steps," and the September deadline just called to say it's leaving.

feed.summary: Implemented Hector (96) — Protector: singles beat doubles when Hector is active on either team (effective rank 2.5 in winner determination), plus +1 damage on any singles win; `PROTECTOR!` callout queued in ghost-rare purple, ported from boobattles reference.
feed.next_up: Implement Toby (97) — Dark Castle ghost-rare. Check boobattles/execution.js for Toby's ability then implement following established patterns.
feed.after_that: Implement Redd (98) — Dark Castle ghost-rare. Check boobattles reference for Redd's ability then implement.
feed.roast: Congrats on teaching scissors to beat rock — Rosewater wrote a whole article warning against this exact kind of "effective rank 2.5" fudge, but sure, ship it in April with five months till Kickstarter.

feed.summary: Implemented Romy (114) — Valley Guardian: before rolling, a teal prediction modal shows 6 number buttons (1–6 die faces); the player's pick is stored in `B.romyPrediction[team]`, narrated as "Romy predicts... X!", then if any winning die matches, +3 damage is added in `resolveRound` with `VALLEY GUARDIAN!` queued in legendary gold. Prediction modal follows the exact Timber/Selene overlay pattern; predictions clear on round reset.
feed.next_up: Implement Hector (96) — Protector (Dark Castle ghost-rare): check boobattles/execution.js for the Protector ability and port faithfully. First ghost-rare from the 113 originals.
feed.after_that: Implement Toby (97) — Dark Castle ghost-rare. Check boobattles reference for Toby's ability then implement following established patterns.
feed.roast: Congrats, you shipped Divination: The Prediction — a mechanic so telegraphed it makes Buttons look like a mind-reader, and somehow Romy's "guess a number 1-6" is still easier to hit than your September deadline.

feed.summary: Implemented Prince Balatron (113) — Party Time: when Balatron loses a roll but survives, rolls 1 counter die (1–6) and immediately deals that damage back to the winner; counter can KO the winner, which handleKOs() catches after the ability queue drains, via `PARTY TIME!` queued in legendary gold in the cinematic section.
feed.next_up: Implement Romy (114) — Valley Guardian: predict a die number before rolling; if any of your dice match, +3 bonus damage. Needs a pre-roll prediction UI (modal or button), a stored `romyPrediction` value on the team state, and a post-roll check in resolveRound's damage section.
feed.after_that: Implement Hector (96) — first ghost-rare from the 113 originals. Check boobattles/execution.js for Hector's ability and port faithfully.
feed.roast: Congrats, you turned "getting punched in the face" into a legendary ability and queued it in gold — Rosewater would call it flavor-forward, Skaff would call it a variance tax on the opponent, and I'm calling it the exact kind of dice-on-dice cope feature that eats a week you don't have before September.
